description: Search active developer jobs. Returns compact JobSpecs (no description) sorted by relevance or recency. Use get_job for details.

collapse.description: Group the same role posted for several locations into one result; same_role_other_locations tells how many more exist.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, e.g. NL, DE, GB.

currency.description: ISO currency code (EUR, USD, GBP). Restricts to jobs that publish pay in this currency.

exclude.description: Leave out jobs matching any of these: a stack tag (not in the primary stack or title), a role family, or a topic like 'crypto' or 'gambling' (not mentioned anywhere, synonyms included).

min_salary.description: Minimum yearly salary (upper end of the published range must reach it). Combine with currency.

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'distributed systems' or 'payments'. Every word must match (a word also matches its synonyms).

regions.description: Any of these regions. Worldwide-remote jobs are always included.

salary_required.description: Only jobs that publish a salary range.

stack.description: Technology tags that must all be in the role's primary stack, lowercase: rust, go, typescript, python, react, postgres, kubernetes, ... Passing mentions (stack_mentioned) do not match.

name: search_jobs
title: Search developer jobs
